title: Market Surveillance
thesis: Snowflake turns daily account activity from a synthetic digital-asset exchange into alert-precision KPIs, 7-day suspicious-activity risk scores, self-match anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Alert precision, alerts raised, SARs filed and notional monitored for 40 accounts across 5 APJ markets.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to account-day rows.
The detection-rule chart shows which rules produce confirmed suspicious activity and which mostly produce false positives.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of surveillance KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which accounts should investigators look at first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each account's probability of confirmed suspicious activity in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent 14 days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags self-match ratio outliers per account, and the forecast projects exchange-wide alert volume for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

talking_points: Periodic review compliance, KYC document coverage and pending documents frame the control gaps.
Review compliance against confirmed alerts by account shows where weak reviews and suspicious activity move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, account, detection-rule and risk tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a suspicious trade lands right now?

talking_points: Live trade events land in RAW.LIVE_TRADES, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALERT events with an SOP hint and the account's current risk band, then emails the investigator.
tabs.call_out: From trade to case in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 14 synthetic investigation SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
